title: Inline reviewer output should use tick/cross bullet list format
description: Review output is currently free-form prose, making it hard to scan for pass/fail status at a glance. When reviewing a run with 10+ rubric criteria, identifying which criteria failed requires reading the entire review body.
proposed_resolution: Update the inline reviewer prompt to output each rubric criterion as a structured bullet: ✓ criterion description (for passes) or ✗ criterion description — reason (for failures). The summary line must be PASS or FAIL followed by a fraction (e.g. 11/14 criteria passed). The explorative analysis section (if present) follows the criterion list as a separate Observations block. This format applies to both complete_review and inline persona review outputs.
